'''1997 Dagobah Regionals (Atlanta)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of three in the Dagobah region (Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi, Florida).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Dagobah)
* '''Date:''' 29 June 1997
* '''Site:''' Dragon Con, Atlanta, Georgia

== Notes ==

* Decipher's 1997 qualifier list names Chris Vickers as the Atlanta qualifier and Shelby Abercrombie as the Mobile qualifier.<ref name="dec97q" />
* Decipher NewsFlash reports Chris Vickers winning the Mobile (Dagobah I) qualifier on 30 May 1997.<ref name="nf97dag">[http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/dagobahqualifier.html A Flood Of Interest: Star Wars CCG Dagobah I Qualifier is Wet 'n' Wild], Jason Winter, Decipher NewsFlash (4 June 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970607092009/http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/dagobahqualifier.html Internet Archive]</ref> The list may have the two qualifiers swapped. No other source names the Atlanta winner.
